note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Two identical desks show the same case file; the only difference is the supplied state of the focus route (concluded on desk A, pending a check on desk B). The other routes are marked identically on both desks with their supplied states. The guide and the neutral note name no winner, score or outcome; no finality doctrine, and nothing says whether any route is closed or available. Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes, outcomes, scenarioA, scenarioB, changedFact, sharedFacts and comparisonLabels are editable (plus focusRoute).
